import json, os
item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
spath = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if not os.path.exists(spath):
    raise RuntimeError("no script.json in " + root + " — run the Script stage first")
with open(spath) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
regen = set(item.get("regen_ids") or [])
chars = {c["id"]: c for c in script.get("characters", [])}
work = []
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, "shots", sid + ".png")) and sid not in regen:
            continue
        blocks = []
        for cid in shot.get("characters", []):
            c = chars.get(cid)
            if c:
                blocks.append({"id": cid, "name": c.get("name", cid), "visual_description": c.get("visual_description", "")})
        work.append({"id": sid, "slug": slug, "image_prompt": shot.get("image_prompt", ""),
                     "style_notes": script.get("style_notes", ""), "character_blocks": blocks,
                     "image_model": item.get("image_model") or "google/gemini-3.1-flash-image"})
if not work:
    raise RuntimeError("All shot images already exist. Enter shot ids (e.g. shot_002) in the form to force regeneration.")
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "shots": work}}]
